'''Premiere &ndash; Death Star II''' is a constructed environment on [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]<ref name="play">[https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com], GEMP. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009095947/https://play.swccg.com/ Internet Archive].</ref> whose legal pool is the Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]]. Its GEMP code is <code>premiere_ds2</code> (display name '''Premiere - Death Star II''').

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}

== Card pool ==

As configured in GEMP <code>swccgFormats.json</code>, the environment includes set ids <code>1&ndash;9</code> plus the premium/reflections ids listed for that format entry (ids <code>101&ndash;111</code>).<ref name="gempfmt">GEMP format list (<code>premiere_ds2</code> / "Premiere - Death Star II") in <code>swccgFormats.json</code> on the play.swccg.com codebase</ref> In plain language: printed Decipher cards from Premiere through Death Star II (and the premium products GEMP maps into those ids). It does '''not''' include later Decipher sets (for example Reflections II / Tatooine / Coruscant / Theed Palace) or Players Committee Virtual Sets unless a specific event document says otherwise.

== Organized play ==

Players Committee online events sometimes use this pool under the label '''Premiere to DSII''' (or similar). Example:

* [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] &mdash; last Decipher Worlds played in this printed pool (Death Star II was the newest expansion).
* [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] &mdash; July&ndash;September 2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship on GEMP.<ref name="pc-retro-2026">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII) &ndash; July to Sept. 2026], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021133413/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.html Internet Archive].</ref>
